brand_descriptor: AI systems integration and corporate asset advisory.
hero_body: Expected results come only from expected methods. Whatever sits inside the industry average, the domestic consensus, or the well-precedented option has already been claimed by someone else. From Singapore, we work across borders and sectors to reach the answers that lie outside the average.
about_body_1: CAUCHYE is named after the Cauchy distribution. Named in turn for the 19th-century mathematician Augustin-Louis Cauchy, it has no expected value: however many samples you draw, the sample mean never converges, and the law of large numbers does not hold. It describes a world where the average is simply not a usable instrument.
about_body_2: That is our starting point. Anything an average can settle has been settled already. What we take on sits outside it — AI implementations with little precedent, platforms that do not yet exist, and cross-border assets that no domestic benchmark describes. Results there cannot be predicted from the mean, which is precisely why they can exceed it.
services_body: We run three lines of business: client engineering, our own product, and advisory. Together they let us take a problem from data model, to deployed system, to the capital decision behind it.
svc_ai_body: Production AI woven into operations that already exist — not proofs of concept. We have delivered across data pipelines, agent workflows, and internal tooling.
svc_ai_point_3: Integration with systems already in place
svc_d6e_body: Our own AI platform. Because it runs in your own environment, you can put AI to work without handing confidential data to a third party. Adoption starts small, and the cost of moving to another platform later stays contained.
svc_d6e_point_1: Adopt AI without sending confidential data outside
svc_d6e_point_2: No lock-in to a single vendor
svc_d6e_point_3: Start small and widen only as needed
svc_capital_body: Advisory on deploying retained earnings, constructing a portfolio, and evaluating M&A — options weighed across the whole balance sheet rather than one instrument at a time.
leader_bio: Graduated in Economics from Kyoto University and completed an MBA at its Graduate School of Management; currently enrolled in the doctoral programme at its Graduate School of Informatics. As a white-hat engineer, recovered crypto assets worth roughly ¥500 million from an active hack. Also serves as Co-General Partner of a construction-materials leasing fund in Singapore, through a subsidiary joint venture.
